name: Velisa Putri
intro: I model, make UGC and do brand deals. If your project needs someone in front of the camera, tell me about it.
bio:
Curly hair, sun-kissed skin, and a lot of energy once the camera's on. I'm natural and expressive in front of a lens, and I'm fun to direct.

I'm early in my career and looking for more work with brands and agencies. If you have a project in mind, send it over, even if it's not on my list.

highlights.title: Modeling
highlights.subtitle: Editorial, lifestyle, lookbooks and product shoots.

highlights.title: UGC
highlights.subtitle: Videos of me talking to camera or using your product, for your page or your ads.

highlights.title: Brand deals
highlights.subtitle: Endorsements and campaigns on my Instagram and TikTok.

highlights.title: Something else
highlights.subtitle: If it needs a person on camera or in the room, ask me.
